paper.title: Neural circuit mechanisms for steering control in walking Drosophila
paper.published_claim: mean rotational velocity is consistently related to the right-minus-left DNa02 firing-rate difference; the relationship is essentially linear across its dynamic range

code_authorities.role: Python import/preprocessing contract and dual-recording aliases
physiology quality-control context; contains a low-SNR rejection of a2_d_14 for a separate physiology analysis

cohort_review_note: Resolved by the frozen cohort adjudication: Figure 3C reports four bilateral right/left DNa02 flies; released Dataverse v1.2 contains exactly four ephys_data_a2_d_* raw folders; pinned secondary-analysis code declares the same four aliases as completed bilateral DNa02 datasets. The a2_d_14 low-SNR rejection remains a scoped caveat from a separate physiology-quantification analysis, not panel-level exclusion evidence for Figure 3C.
